title: Counit scalar maps respect ordinary etale direct-image composition
statement:
Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings. All schemes and morphisms below are arbitrary [def-pc-scheme]. Write $D_R(T)=D(T_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category of constant-ring module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], $Q_T=(-)\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and $u_R^*$ for exact inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Use the canonical K-flat scalar/pullback isomorphism $\lambda_u:u_B^*Q_T\cong Q_Wu_A^*$ for $u:W\to T$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Use the canonical derived adjunction $u_R^*\dashv Ru_{*,R}$ [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. Define $\chi_{u,E}:Q_TRu_{*,A}E\to Ru_{*,B}Q_WE$ to have adjunct $Q_W(\varepsilon_{u,A,E})\circ\lambda_{u,Ru_{*,A}E}$, where $\varepsilon_{u,A}$ is the counit. Let $X\xrightarrow rY\xrightarrow sZ$. Write $\kappa_R:R(sr)_{*,R}\cong Rs_{*,R}Rr_{*,R}$ for the K-injective-normalized direct-image composition [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. For every $M\in D_A(X)$,
$$\kappa_{B,Q_XM}\circ\chi_{sr,M}=Rs_{*,B}(\chi_{r,M})\circ\chi_{s,Rr_{*,A}M}\circ Q_Z(\kappa_{A,M}).$$
Under the canonical identity direct-image comparisons $\chi_{\mathrm{id}}$ is the identity. No properness, Noetherian hypothesis, boundedness, flatness, or invertibility of $\chi$ is asserted.
